Usage: mail-find auth login [flags]

Sign in to --account interactively: a browser for Gmail, a device code for Outlook.

Signs --account in. Gmail opens a browser and waits for its redirect;
Outlook shows a device code to enter at the address it gives. The token is
kept under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mailkit (by default ~/.config/mailkit) for
later runs. It needs the person at the keyboard.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help               Show context-sensitive help.
      --account=ACCOUNT    Which account's mailbox to read. An id from one account means nothing in
                           the other (default: gmail; one of: gmail, outlook).
      --text               Print the human form instead of one JSON document.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
